purpose: Independent external benchmark of Gradiom published pre-vote aggregate forecasts; no model training or promotion.
horizon: Retain printed generation date; require strictly before vote; historical snapshot authenticity not independently certified. No 2026-11-29 data.
metrics: Macro-object equal-municipality MAE in percentage points, centered local MAE, national MAE from published national forecast, equal-canton macro-object MAE when exact canton values available. Score only final/complete published official aggregate counts; label provisional releases. Report actual coverage, unmatched keys and uncertainty across dates.
comparison: Compare same objects on existing frozen V2 2023-25 retrospective comparison results when matched. Equal-geography matched rows required for strict paired commune comparison; if only per-object metrics or geography differs, label indicative. V10.8 score 6.9886 on separate 2016-22 population is contextual only. No fitting or selection on 2023+ results.
provenance: Save URLs, published dates, retrieval time and hashes. Public values only; do not publish full proprietary tables or circumvent access restrictions.
